# Teton Peaks AI

> Done-for-you missed-call text back and AI automation. Our main focus is electricians anywhere in the US. We also serve small businesses in Idaho Falls and the Snake River Valley of Eastern Idaho. Teton Peaks AI is a dba of Prooformance LLC, based in Idaho Falls, Idaho.

Founded by Connor Wills, whose background is in enterprise cloud and AI partnerships, to bring enterprise AI to small and medium businesses. Electricians anywhere in the US work with Teton Peaks AI by phone or online. In the Snake River Valley, Connor also meets owners in person.

- Phone: 208-710-6351 (call or text)
- Email: connor@gettetonpeaksai.com
- Main focus: electricians (residential service and repair shops), anywhere in the US, by phone or online
- Local service area: Idaho Falls, Ammon, Rexburg, Rigby, Pocatello, Chubbuck, Blackfoot, Shelley, St. Anthony, Driggs, Victor
- Book a free AI process consultation: https://calendly.com/tetonpeaksai/free-ai-process-consultation
- Free consultation length: 15 minutes

## Services and prices
- Missed-Call Rescue Pilot: $297 one-time, 30 days, plus carrier texting fees at cost. You get your $297 back if it does not win back at least one missed-call lead in 30 days. Texting registration is paid at cost and isn't refunded.
- Missed-Call Rescue: $147/month plus $497 setup. Missed-call text back, alerts, monthly report.
- Lead Engine: $297/month plus $997 setup. Adds fast replies to web and Facebook leads, a booking link, and review requests.
- AI Front Desk: $497/month plus $2,497 setup. Adds an AI receptionist that answers, asks the right questions, and books 24/7.
- AI Process Audit: $1,500. A written plan, credited toward a build.
- Custom Build: from $3,000 setup plus $500/month.
- Back-Office Integrations (QuickBooks invoice reminders, CRM cleanup, job-to-invoice handoffs): scoped as a Custom Build.
- Also offered, priced on the consultation call: past-customer reactivation campaigns, website chat and FAQ bot, staff AI training workshops, fractional AI advisor retainer, local search and AI search visibility, outbound voice agent (AI Front Desk add-on).
- Industry bundles: dental recall and no-show reduction, property management maintenance triage, trades quote follow-up, restaurant catering and reservations.
